title: Close enough to visit
body: We are in Rampurhat, not in a city where your project becomes a ticket number. Distance matters when software has to work at a counter on a Monday morning.

title: Scope written down
body: Every project begins with a document you can read and question. What we build, what we do not, what it costs and when it arrives. No moving target.

title: Software people use
body: A system that staff avoid is a failed system. We design for the person at the counter, not for a demo audience, and we train until the work feels ordinary.
